ops.text: The damage depends on how long the model runs: even for a constant-size Mamba cache, Singh (2026) estimates that low-precision storage would need about five more bits per state entry at 256K tokens than at its training length.

new_bib.text: V. Singh (2026). Fixed state, long reach: what a constant-size cache buys block diffusion at scale. arXiv preprint arXiv:2609.11998.
